children: Visium Technologies executed a non-binding term sheet to assign specified device contract-use, offtake, and deployment rights into a newly formed Indonesian PMA vehicle.
Executed non-binding term sheet to assign identified device design rights into newly formed PT Visium Compute Indonesia.
Wholly owned Delaware subsidiary would hold 99% of the PMA company; local nominee holds 1% with drag/tag/ROFR protections.
Transaction is an assignment of rights, not an acquisition of an operating company or assumption of historical liabilities.
Economic terms, including Series F non-voting convertible preferred stock consideration, remain subject to Board approval.
Closing is conditioned on numerous consents, regulatory approvals, export controls, capital availability, and Florida corporate approvals; no assurance of closing.
